incident-bot: <!pagerduty> ALERT: Opalshore (VPC - eu-west-1, dedicated pool) elevated 5xx rate on model redwood-gpt-lite-8k. 17% errors over 5m for tenant=opalshore. Affects /v1/generate. Paging on-call. Ticket INC-2025-341
ryan.oncall: On it, joining bridge now. Will triage and propose mitigations.
maya.sre: I'm on the bridge. Quick question — seen any recent canary or deploys for that tenant? logs show repeated grpc 502/504s and occasional OOM hints.
ryan.oncall: no deploys in last 12h. Host metrics show GC spikes and mem pressure on gpu-3. I want to reduce concurrency and pin tenant to a lower-memory safe variant.
lucas.eng-runtime: Recommend pin -> redwood-gpt-stable-1.5b-quant (smaller KV and quantized). Adds stability for heavy tail. Pin payload below.
lucas.eng-runtime: ```bash
# control plane pin via API
curl -X POST "https://control.redwood/api/v1/tenants/opalshore/pin" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-gpt-stable-1.5b-quant","reason":"auto-mitigation - high 5xx"}'

# or rwctl CLI
rwctl tenant pin --tenant opalshore --model redwood-gpt-stable-1.5b-quant --force
```
sam.acct-eng: @opalshore-admin do you want immediate pin or a 10% canary first? Customer impact looks high.
opalshore-admin: Immediate pin please. Production traffic failing, we need a full switch. Keep us in the loop.

deploy-bot: Action log: tenant pin applied by ryan.oncall at 4990012354. Model -> redwood-gpt-stable-1.5b-quant. Concurrency limit 4. Canary: disabled (customer requested full).
maya.sre: Metrics: error rate 17% -> 8.7% after 20s -> 3.2% after 40s. Latency stabilized. KV cache miss rate reduced. Looks good so far.
opalshore-admin: Observed successful responses returning for major flows. Thank you.
ryan.oncall: Holding for 15m observation window. If stable we'll keep pin and schedule root-cause follow-up. Please add CAPA: model mem regression and stress tests to postmortem.
lucas.eng-runtime: I'll follow up with a PR to tenant auto-fallback rules so safe-variant is included in tenant config (prevents manual pin next time).
